data.original_input: Explore debug-opus-bad-requests for Anthropic/opencode request construction, thinking/effort mapping, variant handling, and 400 error context.

notes: Builds variant options from model.variants + input.user.variant (disabled when small).
Agent thinking config is mapped to ThinkingEffort defaults and converted via buildThinkingOptions().
For @ai-sdk/anthropic, buildThinkingOptions returns thinking {type: enabled, budgetTokens} plus effort at top-level.
Options are merged in order: ProviderTransform.options → smallOptions → thinkingOptions → model.options → agent.options → variant.
ProviderTransform.providerOptions wraps options by SDK key (anthropic, bedrock, etc) before streamText.
Errors are logged in streamText onError without request payload context.
normalizeMessages strips empty content for Anthropic and normalizes toolCallIds for Claude.
applyCaching adds providerOptions cacheControl for Anthropic/OpenRouter/Bedrock.
message() remaps providerOptions keys to SDK key (anthropic) when providerID differs.
variants() defines reasoning presets; for @ai-sdk/anthropic only high/max map to thinking budgets (no effort).
maxOutputTokens() inflates max_tokens when thinking is enabled (budgetTokens + output limit).
Anthropic custom loader injects anthropic-beta headers including effort-2025-11-24.
This header is present for all Anthropic SDK requests, not gated to specific models.
Agent definitions can include thinking, which feeds LLM.stream mapping.
CLI supports --variant to pick provider-specific reasoning effort presets (e.g., high, max, minimal).
Default budgets: low=4k, medium=10k, high=16k; clamped per provider in buildThinkingOptions().

prior_art: No learn-retrospective packets found in .agents/messages (glob returned none).
Repo search for claude-opus-4-5 found only fixtures and console example; no stored 400 error logs or payloads.
patterns: Variants are provider-specific reasoning presets derived from ProviderTransform.variants and merged after agent/model options.
Agent thinking config is separate from variants and is mapped to provider-specific options in LLM.buildThinkingOptions.
ProviderOptions are namespaced by SDK key via ProviderTransform.providerOptions and remapped in ProviderTransform.message.
raw_options: Add sanitized logging around LLM.stream options/providerOptions and error payloads for anthropic/opencode calls.
Run config-only toggles (disable agent thinking, remove variant) to isolate whether effort/thinking triggers 400.
Compare current effort/thinking shape to Vercel AI Gateway docs and Anthropic effort beta requirements.
Check tool_choice + thinking compatibility when tools are forced (known AI SDK limitation).
Confirm whether effort should be passed under output_config or providerOptions for Opus 4.5.
